ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link regulatory layers to cell states at single-cell resolution
ranked.summary: Four-omics single-cell assays and 1.2M-profile spatial models now allow regulatory and cell-state inference within unified computational frameworks.

ranked.headline: Learned models pair protein embeddings with experimental constraints for prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair pretrained protein language models and ML potentials with experimental data for binding, structure and dynamics.

ranked.headline: Language models and searchable resources mine microbial genomes for defense systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release searchable phage, extreme-environment, and pathogen gene-level resources alongside defense-discovery models.

ranked.headline: Omics tools converge on portable, scalable, and reproducible workflow infrastructure
ranked.summary: Datasets routinely exceed system memory, making data access the primary bottleneck and prompting standardized formats and environments.

ranked.headline: Multiomic single-cell methods resolve regulatory and transcript heterogeneity in tissues
ranked.summary: Single-cell and multiomic tools now separate cell-state regulation from bulk-averaged signals across brain, placenta, and heart datasets.

ranked.headline: Long-read and metagenomic tools expand microbial profiling and annotation accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal releases apply deep learning, structure search, and GPU acceleration to sequencing data analysis workflows.

ranked.headline: Deep networks on protein language embeddings predict disorder, binding and function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published studies extend pLM-based deep learning from structure and disorder to affinity, pose, and enzyme function prediction.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning infers regulatory and molecular interactions
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence embeddings are increasingly fused with graph and structure encoders across regulatory and interaction prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Coupling structure and emergent dynamics linked across neural scales via formal models
ranked.summary: Connectome-scale, oscillatory, and manifold-level analyses now test how coupling across neural levels shapes dynamics.

ranked.headline: Latent models encode regulatory and spatial structure in single-cell transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Multimodal and spatial transcriptomic datasets now demand representations that encode regulatory mechanism, tissue context, and cross-modal correspondence.

ranked.headline: Mosaic and somatic variant detection improves with reference and error modelling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend somatic and mosaic variant detection across cfDNA, bulk STRs, and pangenome references.

ranked.headline: Computation now sets construct and linker design for GPCR and antibody targets
ranked.summary: Computation is shifting upstream, from analyzing complexes to fixing the experimental construct itself, as in linker and fusion-protein design.

ranked.headline: Computational tools address QC, splicing, and fragment features in sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers release open-source tools spanning sequencing QC, somatic variant classification, and splicing and cfDNA analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned models map heterogeneous biological data to drug and antibiotic response
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether learned models generalize across cohorts, cell lines, and biological scales, with uncertainty and LLM reasoning under scrutiny.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking learned models for biological prediction under imbalance and censoring
ranked.summary: Recent work evaluates biological prediction models under explicit feature reduction, class imbalance, response contamination, and censoring conditions.

ranked.headline: Representation choices reshape inferred protein dynamics; new tools cut analysis costs
ranked.summary: Representation choice now changes inferred MD transitions, and new tools target GPU simulation, sampling, flexibility prediction, and trajectory storage.

ranked.headline: Sampling methods map peptide folding, binding pathways and designed protein stability
ranked.summary: Ensemble-level sampling resolves intermediates, free energetics and design outcomes that single static structures leave unexplained.

ranked.headline: K-mer statistics now infer mutation rates, phylogenies, and genome properties from reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply k-mer counting directly to raw reads for mutation rates, shallow phylogenies, and genome size estimation.

ranked.headline: Genome assemblies across taxa reveal ploidy, duplication, and stress-response genes
ranked.summary: Recent assemblies from fungi, diatoms, amoebozoans, spiders, and nematodes expose ploidy, duplication, and stress-response variation.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and multimodal models for biology face distribution shift and missing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test learned biological models under distribution shift, missing modalities, batch effects, and limited labels.

ranked.headline: Integrated detection, segmentation and tracking tools for time-series microscopy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool bundle segmentation, detection and lineage tracking into reusable microscopy analysis workflows.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and spatial data integrated into metabolic and organelle-scale models
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, and proteome localization data with computational models at network and organelle scales.

ranked.headline: Automated frameworks assign cell identity in spatial and single-cell omics data
ranked.summary: Multi-agent LLM annotation and integrated spatial pipelines now automate cell typing with AI-enabled interpretation across recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Computational methods probe protein conformational ensembles and residue energetics
ranked.summary: AI-predicted structures are being reweighted, sampled, and scored for conformational and energetic consequences rather than read as static models.

ranked.headline: Biological foundation models: evaluation of uncertainty, geometry, and generative quality
ranked.summary: Recent papers test whether protein and genomic foundation models give calibrated uncertainty, faithful geometry, and reliable generative evaluation metrics.

ranked.headline: Graph and knowledge-based scoring of protein complexes and metal binding sites
ranked.summary: Recent methods pair graph neural networks and knowledge-based potentials with public benchmarks to score complexes, pKa values, and metal sites.

ranked.headline: Population-scale and long-read methods resolve immunoglobulin locus genetics
ranked.summary: Population-scale Ig genetics and long-read V(D)J profiling now enable locus-level analysis of human B-cell immunity.

ranked.headline: Population-scale resources and variant predictors undergo empirical benchmarking
ranked.summary: Recent reports add a 1,116-genome Chinese pangenome and experimental benchmarks of variant effect predictors across population-scale datasets.

ranked.headline: Steering pretrained generative models toward explicit objectives in biomolecular design
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 papers pair protein, peptide, and 3D molecule generators with explicit control inputs, guidance, or conditioning.

ranked.headline: Posterior models resolve genetic and regulatory effects across multi-dataset designs
ranked.summary: Colocalisation now spans hundreds to thousands of GWAS datasets as mediation and G×E models gain formal guarantees.

ranked.headline: Physics-inspired and quantum models reframe gene regulation, chromatin and metabolism
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair quantum-circuit, spin-glass and entropy-based formalisms with sequence, contact and single-cell data to infer biological interactions.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale tests of selection theory and diagnostics for dated and Bayesian phylogenies
ranked.summary: Recent work tests nearly neutral and seasonal selection models against genome data and adds diagnostics for dated and Bayesian phylogenetic assumptions.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide metrics of inbreeding, erosion, and introgression in dogs, birds, and lynx
ranked.summary: Low-coverage sequencing and deep learning now enable genome-scale estimates of inbreeding, diversity loss, and introgression.

ranked.headline: Coupled mechanistic models link local cell dynamics to tissue-scale spatial patterns
ranked.summary: Spatially explicit simulations now test how chemoattractant gradients, cytokine diffusion, and hemodynamics shape cell behavior in situ.

ranked.headline: Multi-genome frameworks extend plant genome analysis beyond single reference assemblies
ranked.summary: Pangenome-scale analyses now capture noncoding sequence and regulatory elements alongside genes in orange and polyploid Brassica genomes.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test proteomics quantification, stability prediction, and agentic retrieval
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark proteomics quantification, folding stability prediction, and LLM agent retrieval workflows.

ranked.headline: Bias-corrected EEG phase and oscillator tracking reveal state-dependent rhythm shifts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published work address edge-filter bias in EEG phase estimation and interpretable resting-state features tied to disease and medication state.

ranked.headline: Reusable databases and tools for gene identifiers, ac4C sites, mirtrons and vesicle cargo
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release identifier, annotation and prediction resources spanning up to 33 species for reuse by downstream analyses.

ranked.headline: Language models and integer programming redesign synonymous coding sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply language models, reinforcement learning, and integer programming to codon and mRNA sequence design.

ranked.headline: Mathematical models map thresholds and bistability in immune and tumor dynamics
ranked.summary: ODE frameworks now quantify tumor persistence, CAR T-cell tunability, and bistable disease states, with transcriptomic tests in rheumatic disease.
